name: phase279-groq-compound-mini-remote-status-only-control
probe_prompt: A remote side effect timed out after dispatch. An authenticated remote_status record exists. No delivery_receipt exists. Extract available durable evidence only. Return exactly one raw JSON object with keys risk, available_evidence, complete_pair, canonical_writes. risk must be unknown_effect; available_evidence must contain only remote_status; complete_pair must be false; canonical_writes must be 0. Do not invent missing evidence or choose RETRY, RECONCILE, or DEFER. No markdown or extra text.
